人教版 选择性必修1 第四章第二节「电解池」（电解饱和食盐水）: PEP Chemistry Elective Required Book 1 · Ch. 4 Sec. 2 "Electrolytic Cells" (electrolysis of saturated brine)
同样的电，怎样换来更多烧碱、更少电耗，又不出事故？: With the same electricity, how do you get more caustic soda, use less power, and avoid accidents?
通电把盐水拆成 Cl₂、H₂、NaOH: Electricity splits brine into Cl₂, H₂ and NaOH
阳离子膜放 Na⁺ 带水通过，挡住 Cl⁻ 与 OH⁻: The cation membrane lets Na⁺ through with water and blocks Cl⁻ and OH⁻
钙镁不结垢，电流效率才守得住: No calcium/magnesium scale keeps current efficiency up
电流密度↑ → 产量成正比涨、电耗也涨: Current density ↑ → output rises proportionally, and so does power use
动一个控件的代价，曲线和读数同时给你看: See the cost of moving one control in the curve and readings at once
全对！从膜到电耗这条链你已经理顺了。: All correct! You've got the chain from membrane to power use straight.
建议回到第 2、4、5 步，把精制、膜、电耗三件事再看一遍。: Go back to steps 2, 4 and 5 and review purification, the membrane and power use again.
Ca²⁺、Mg²⁺ 会在膜里结垢: Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ form scale in the membrane
阳极室（+x）：Cl⁻ 放电出 Cl₂: Anode chamber (+x): Cl⁻ discharges to give Cl₂
阴极室（−x）：水得电子出 H₂ + OH⁻: Cathode chamber (−x): water gains electrons to give H₂ + OH⁻
阳极室：Cl⁻ 放电出 Cl₂: Anode chamber: Cl⁻ discharges to give Cl₂
阴极室：水得电子出 H₂ 和 OH⁻: Cathode chamber: water gains electrons to give H₂ and OH⁻
球色只表示离子种类：Na⁺ 蓝 · Cl⁻ 绿 · OH⁻ 红: Ball colors only show ion type: Na⁺ blue · Cl⁻ green · OH⁻ red
膜已拆：Cl₂ 与 OH⁻ 互窜: Membrane removed: Cl₂ and OH⁻ cross over
化盐 → 一次化学精制 → 过滤 → 二次螯合树脂: Dissolve salt → primary chemical purification → filtration → secondary chelating resin
阳极 Cl₂、阴极 H₂ 与 NaOH，中间一层膜: Cl₂ at the anode, H₂ and NaOH at the cathode, a membrane in between
冷却 → 浓硫酸干燥 → 压缩液化 → 液氯: Cool → dry with concentrated sulfuric acid → compress and liquefy → liquid chlorine
碱液吸收，不直接放空: Absorbed in caustic, never vented directly
开停车时放空燃烧: Vented and burned at startup and shutdown
一座氯碱厂，为什么同时送出烧碱、氯气和氢气？: Why does one chlor-alkali plant ship out caustic soda, chlorine and hydrogen all at once?
拖动视角，从左到右看一遍这座厂（滚轮拉近拉远）: Drag the view and look over the plant from left to right (scroll to zoom)
参考工况 3.3 kA/m²、90 ℃：产碱 30.31 t/d、吨碱电耗 21: Reference case 3.3 kA/m², 90 ℃: caustic output 30.31 t/d and power use 2187 kW·h/t running, with depleted brine already returning to the dissolver.
一套装置给三样产品：阴极得 H₂ 和 NaOH，阳极得 Cl₂，所以氯碱厂天然是: One unit gives three products: H₂ and NaOH at the cathode, Cl₂ at the anode, so a chlor-alkali plant is naturally "three in one".
精制（①）只做一件事：把盐水里的钙镁洗掉，替②的膜挡掉结垢。: Purification (①) does one thing: washes calcium and magnesium out of the brine to keep scale out of the membrane in ②.
氯气（③）、氢气（④）、烧碱（⑤）是电解之后三条并联的产品线，不是串联。: Chlorine (③), hydrogen (④) and caustic soda (⑤) are three parallel product lines after electrolysis, not a series.
去掉电解这一步：三条产品线全部无料可处理，全厂停产。: Skip electrolysis and the three product lines have nothing to process; the whole plant stops.
常考「电解饱和食盐水得到什么」：阴极 H₂ 与 NaOH、阳极 Cl₂；不是金属: Often tested "what does electrolysis of saturated brine give": H₂ and NaOH at the cathode, Cl₂ at the anode; not sodium metal.
一套电解装置同时产三样：Cl₂、H₂、NaOH。原料只有食盐和水，难的是把产物分: One electrolysis unit makes three things at once: Cl₂, H₂ and NaOH. The raw materials are just salt and water; the hard part is separating the products while keeping efficiency, which is the job of the membrane in the middle.
原料只是食盐和水，为什么进槽前要先把盐水洗一遍？: The raw materials are just salt and water, so why must the brine be cleaned before entering the cell?
把「盐水精制」切断，盯着电流效率看: Cut off "Brine purification" and watch the current efficiency
电流效率从 95 % 开始往下掉（每 6 s 掉 1 个百分点，最低 80 %）: Current efficiency starts falling from 95 % (1 percentage point every 6 s, down to 80 %) and power use rises with it; switching it back on only stops the fall, it doesn't recover.
一次精制后 Ca²⁺+Mg²⁺ ≤ 5 mg/L；二次螯合树脂 ≤ 20 μg/: After primary purification Ca²⁺+Mg²⁺ ≤ 5 mg/L; after secondary chelating resin ≤ 20 μg/L
一次精制用化学沉淀 + 过滤，把 Ca²⁺+Mg²⁺ 降到 ≤ 5 mg/L。: Primary purification uses chemical precipitation + filtration to bring Ca²⁺+Mg²⁺ down to ≤ 5 mg/L.
离子膜要求更高：再过螯合树脂塔做二次精制，降到 ≤ 20 μg/L。: The ion membrane demands more: a chelating resin tower does secondary purification down to ≤ 20 μg/L.
只有两条硬约束：Na₂CO₃ 必须在 BaCl₂ 之后（顺带沉淀过量 Ba²⁺）: There are only two hard constraints: Na₂CO₃ must come after BaCl₂ (to precipitate excess Ba²⁺ as well), and HCl must come after filtration (or the precipitate redissolves); where NaOH is added is a process choice.
去掉精制：钙镁在膜里结垢，电流效率掉下来修不回来。下一步开局视同换新膜（课件设定: Skip purification and calcium and magnesium scale up in the membrane, and the current efficiency drops for good. The next step starts as if with a new membrane (lesson setting), so you'll see efficiency back at 95 %.
常考两点：盐水为什么要两次精制；沉淀剂顺序的两条硬约束（其余不是「必须」）。: Two points often tested: why brine is purified twice; the two hard constraints on precipitant order (the rest is not "required").
Ca²⁺、Mg²⁺ 进膜后生成 Ca(OH)₂、Mg(OH)₂ 沉积在靠阴极的羧: Once Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ enter the membrane they form Ca(OH)₂ and Mg(OH)₂ deposits in the carboxylate layer on the cathode side: current efficiency falls and cell voltage rises, and the damage is irreversible.
一层膜夹在两块电极板中间，它到底把什么分开？: A membrane sits between two electrode plates: what exactly does it separate?
拖动视角，从剖开的那一面看两个室: Drag the view and look at the two chambers from the cut-away side
阳极室（+x）里是黄绿色气泡，阴极室（−x）里是近白气泡，中间一片半透明的膜；阳: The anode chamber (+x) has yellow-green bubbles, the cathode chamber (−x) nearly white bubbles, with a translucent membrane between; anolyte and catholyte are kept separate.
阴极得电子的是水，不是 Na⁺: It's water, not Na⁺, that gains electrons at the cathode
阳极是钛基涂钌铱：催化层让 Cl⁻ 优先放电、把水的析氧压住，否则氯气纯度下降、: The anode is titanium coated with ruthenium/iridium: the catalytic layer lets Cl⁻ discharge first and suppresses oxygen evolution from water; otherwise chlorine purity drops and the anode corrodes.
阴极是镍基活性涂层：降低析氢过电位，水得电子生成 H₂ 和 OH⁻。: The cathode has a nickel-based active coating that lowers the hydrogen overpotential; water gains electrons to form H₂ and OH⁻.
阴极得电子的是水，不是 Na⁺——水溶液里 Na⁺ 不放电，电解熔融 NaCl: It's water, not Na⁺, that gains electrons at the cathode; Na⁺ doesn't discharge in aqueous solution, and sodium metal is only obtained by electrolyzing molten NaCl.
去掉这一层膜：产物不再被分开，后果见第 ⑦ 步。: Remove this membrane and the products are no longer separated; see step ⑦ for the consequences.
常考「阴极产物为什么不是 Na」：水溶液中 Na⁺ 不放电，阴极是 2H₂O +: Often tested "why isn't the cathode product Na": Na⁺ doesn't discharge in aqueous solution; the cathode reaction is 2H₂O + 2e⁻ → H₂↑ + 2OH⁻.
两块电极各管一半：+x 侧 Cl⁻ 放电出 Cl₂，−x 侧水得电子出 H₂ 和: Each electrode handles half: on the +x side Cl⁻ discharges to Cl₂, on the −x side water gains electrons to give H₂ and OH⁻; the membrane separates the chambers so the products don't mix.
离子交换膜让什么通过、又把什么挡回去？: What does the ion-exchange membrane let through, and what does it turn back?
在 3D 里点一下槽前那块放大板上的膜: In 3D, click the membrane on the magnified panel in front of the cell
Na⁺ 带着水从阳极室（+x）跳进阴极室（−x）；Cl⁻ 留在 +x 侧、OH⁻: Na⁺ hops with water from the anode chamber (+x) into the cathode chamber (−x); Cl⁻ stays on the +x side and OH⁻ on the −x side, bouncing back when they near the membrane.
阳离子交换膜：只放 Na⁺ 带水通过: Cation-exchange membrane: lets only Na⁺ through with water
膜是多层复合膜：靠阳极的磺酸层厚、电阻低，管的是槽电压。: The membrane is a multilayer composite: the sulfonate layer on the anode side is thick and low-resistance, governing cell voltage.
靠阴极的羧酸层薄、排斥 OH⁻，管的是电流效率——这一层做不好，效率就到不了实用: The carboxylate layer on the cathode side is thin and repels OH⁻, governing current efficiency; if this layer isn't right, efficiency can't reach practical levels.
Na⁺ 从一个固定负电荷跳到下一个，同时带大量水过去；所以阴极室要持续补纯水，把: Na⁺ hops from one fixed negative charge to the next, carrying a lot of water with it, so the cathode chamber needs a steady supply of pure water to hold the caustic around 32 %.
去掉膜的排斥：Cl⁻ 与 OH⁻ 互窜，烧碱被污染、电流效率下降（见第 ⑦ 步）: Remove the membrane's repulsion and Cl⁻ and OH⁻ cross over: the caustic is contaminated and current efficiency falls (see step ⑦).
常考「离子交换膜是什么膜」：阳离子交换膜，只让 Na⁺（带着水）通过，Cl⁻ 与: Often tested "what kind of membrane is the ion-exchange membrane": a cation-exchange membrane that lets only Na⁺ (with water) through, while Cl⁻ and OH⁻ are repelled by fixed negative charges.
固定负电荷排斥阴离子，只放 Na⁺ 带水通过：挡 Cl⁻ 保住烧碱纯度，挡 OH: Fixed negative charges repel anions and let only Na⁺ through with water: blocking Cl⁻ keeps the caustic pure, blocking OH⁻ keeps the current efficiency up.
想让这座厂多产烧碱，把电流密度加大就行吗？: To make more caustic soda, is it enough to raise the current density?
把电流密度从 3.3 拖到 6.0 kA/m²，看曲线上的点怎么走: Drag the current density from 3.3 to 6.0 kA/m² and watch the point move along the curves
产碱 30.31 → 55.11 t/d，吨碱电耗 2187 → 2712 kW: Caustic output 30.31 → 55.11 t/d, power use 2187 → 2712 kW·h/t, cell voltage 3.100 → 3.845 V, and the risk bar rises too.
32 % NaOH、90 ℃、η 0.95（由手册公式计算 · 课件拟合参数）: 32 % NaOH, 90 ℃, η 0.95 (computed from handbook formulas · lesson-fitted parameters)
产量与电流密度成正比，槽电压只是线性上升——斜率固定、截距 2.19 V 不为零: Output is proportional to current density, while cell voltage only rises linearly: the slope is fixed and the 2.19 V intercept isn't zero.
所以电耗涨得比产量慢，但绝对值确实在涨：多产碱一定要多付电费。: So power use rises more slowly than output, but it does rise in absolute terms: more caustic always costs more electricity.
手册的分级：3.5–4.5 kA/m² 属中电流密度，4.5–6.0 属高，超过: Handbook classes: 3.5–4.5 kA/m² is medium current density, 4.5–6.0 is high, above 6.0 is ultra-high, which strains both cell and membrane.
去掉这一步：学生会以为电流越大越划算，看不到电耗这条并行的账。: Skip this step and students think more current is always more economical, missing the parallel account of power use.
常考「电流密度与槽电压、电耗的关系」：线性增加但不成正比（截距不为零），与电流密: Often tested "relation of current density to cell voltage and power use": linear increase but not proportional (non-zero intercept); output is what's proportional to current density.
产量随电流密度成正比涨，吨碱电耗也随槽电压线性涨；两者一起涨，才有「折中」这道题: Output rises in proportion to current density, and power per tonne rises linearly with cell voltage; both rise together, which is why there's a "trade-off" question.
槽温只差几度，为什么也算进成本？: Why do just a few degrees of cell temperature count in the cost?
把槽温从 90 拖到 85 ℃，看槽电压和电耗: Drag the cell temperature from 90 to 85 ℃ and watch the cell voltage and power use
3.3 kA/m² 下 90 → 85 ℃：槽电压 3.100 → 3.532: At 3.3 kA/m², 90 → 85 ℃: cell voltage 3.100 → 3.532 V, power use 2187 → 2492 kW·h/t, output still 30.31 t/d.
温度系数 0.095 /℃（手册 5.5.1）；85 / 90 / 95 ℃ 三: Temperature coefficient 0.095 /℃ (handbook 5.5.1); 85 / 90 / 95 ℃ on the same formula
槽温升高，膜里离子迁移更容易、电阻变小，槽电压与吨碱电耗一起下降。: Higher cell temperature makes ion migration in the membrane easier and resistance lower, so cell voltage and power per tonne both fall.
但槽温不是越高越好：碱浓度会掉、膜效率有最佳峰值、氯气含水与设备腐蚀都加重。: But hotter isn't always better: caustic concentration drops, membrane efficiency has an optimum peak, and moisture in chlorine and equipment corrosion get worse.
所以工业把槽温稳在 90 ℃ 左右，本课的考核步也把槽温锁在 90 ℃。: So industry holds the cell at about 90 ℃, and this lesson's assessment step also locks it at 90 ℃.
去掉这一步：只看电流密度，会漏掉另一条同样进成本的变量。: Skip this step and, looking only at current density, you miss another variable that equally affects cost.
常考「提高槽温好不好」：槽电压降、电耗降，但膜效率有最佳峰值，还要顾氯气含水与腐: Often tested "is raising cell temperature good": cell voltage and power use fall, but membrane efficiency has an optimum peak, and chlorine moisture and corrosion must be considered.
槽温经槽电压直接影响电耗：90 ℃ 是工业标准温度，降到 85 ℃ 时每吨碱要多: Cell temperature affects power use directly through cell voltage: 90 ℃ is the industrial standard, and at 85 ℃ each tonne of caustic costs 305 kW·h more (2187 → 2492 kW·h/t).
把这层膜抽掉，槽里会发生什么？: Pull this membrane out: what happens in the cell?
把「离子交换膜」切成已拆膜，看放大板上的产物去向: Switch "Ion-exchange membrane" to removed and watch where the products go on the magnified panel
放大板上 Cl₂ 与 OH⁻ 互窜、膜面变灰；顶栏报警，四个读数显示「—」——无: On the magnified panel Cl₂ and OH⁻ cross over and the membrane surface turns gray; the top bar alarms and the four readings show "—": this lesson doesn't compute readings for a membraneless cell; this step is about where the products go.
冷稀碱写法；90 ℃、32 % 热浓碱下主要生成氯酸钠 3Cl₂ + 6NaOH: This is the cold dilute caustic form; in hot concentrated 32 % caustic at 90 ℃ the main product is sodium chlorate: 3Cl₂ + 6NaOH → 5NaCl + NaClO₃ + 3H₂O
氢氯在同一空间: Hydrogen and chlorine in one space
① 氯气被碱吸收：教材写法（常温）是 Cl₂ + 2NaOH → NaCl +: ① Chlorine is absorbed by the caustic: the textbook form (room temperature) is Cl₂ + 2NaOH → NaCl + NaClO + H₂O; hot concentrated 32 % caustic at 90 ℃ mainly forms sodium chlorate; the caustic is contaminated and chlorine is wasted.
② OH⁻ 反渗到阳极室，抬高阳极液 pH，促生成 HClO / ClO₃⁻，腐: ② OH⁻ back-migrates into the anode chamber, raising the anolyte pH and promoting HClO / ClO₃⁻, which corrode the anode and lower chlorine purity.
H₂ 与 Cl₂ 混在同一空间，在一定组成与条件下受光照、火花等引发才可能爆炸—: H₂ and Cl₂ in the same space can explode only at certain compositions and conditions when triggered by light, sparks and so on, not on any exposure to light. In practice, hydrogen-in-chlorine analysis + interlock shutdown guards against this.
去掉这一步：学生会把膜当成一块「隔板」，看不出它同时管着纯度和安全。: Skip this step and students see the membrane as just a "partition", missing that it governs both purity and safety.
常考「没有膜会怎样」：烧碱被次氯酸盐污染，且 H₂ 与 Cl₂ 混合在一定条件下: Often tested "what happens without the membrane": the caustic is contaminated with hypochlorite, and an H₂/Cl₂ mixture may explode under certain conditions.
没有膜，Cl₂ 与 NaOH 反应把烧碱污染，H₂ 与 Cl₂ 也混到了一起；膜: Without the membrane, Cl₂ reacts with NaOH and contaminates the caustic, and H₂ and Cl₂ mix; the membrane's second role is a safety barrier.
产量和电耗同时卡死时，你调哪一个？: When output and power use are both constrained, which do you adjust?
在操作带里把产碱调到 ≥ 28 t/d、吨碱电耗 ≤ 2300 kW·h/t，并: Within the operating band, get caustic output ≥ 28 t/d and power use ≤ 2300 kW·h/t, and hold for 15 s
进入 5 s 后夜班会把电流调低一次（产碱掉到 23.88 t/d），要自己拉回: 5 s in, the night shift turns the current down once (output drops to 23.88 t/d) and you must bring it back; once passed, the goal bar turns green.
P ≥ 28 t/d · W ≤ 2300 kW·h/t · 保持 15 s: P ≥ 28 t/d · W ≤ 2300 kW·h/t · hold 15 s
折 100% NaOH；槽温锁 90 ℃: As 100% NaOH; cell temperature locked at 90 ℃
产量随电流密度成正比涨，电耗也跟着涨，两条线一起看才能在操作带里活下去。: Output rises in proportion to current density and power use follows; only by watching both lines can you survive in the operating band.
电耗这条线把上界压到 3.88 kA/m²：3.9 已经是 2303.8 kW·: The power line caps the upper bound at 3.88 kA/m²: 3.9 is already 2303.8 kW·h/t, over the limit.
1.0 kA/m² 电耗最低（1740 kW·h/t），但产碱只有 9.18 t: 1.0 kA/m² has the lowest power use (1740 kW·h/t), but output is only 9.18 t/d and the equipment investment can't be recovered, so plants don't use it.
越过 6.5 kA/m² 会走「3 s 倒计时 → 穿膜 → 事故 → 复盘 →: Going past 6.5 kA/m² triggers "3 s countdown → membrane breach → accident → review → repair"; understand this chain.
常考「为什么不取电耗最低点」：产量太小，设备与人工摊不回来；工业取折中的操作带。: Often tested "why not run at the lowest power use": output is too small to cover equipment and labor; industry uses a compromise operating band.
只有 3.1–3.8 kA/m² 同时满足两个约束（3.0 只有 27.55 t: Only 3.1–3.8 kA/m² satisfies both constraints (3.0 gives only 27.55 t/d, 3.9 is already 2303.8 kW·h/t); the compromise is calculated, not memorized.
无膜槽本课不计算读数，这一步看产物去向: This lesson doesn't compute readings for a membraneless cell; this step is about where the products go
吨碱电耗 / 产碱 — 电流密度: Power per tonne / output vs current density
本班目标：产碱 ≥ 28 t/d 且电耗 ≤ 2300: Class goal: output ≥ 28 t/d and power ≤ 2300
本班目标：操作带内产碱 ≥ 28 t/d、吨碱电耗 ≤ 2300 kW·h/t，: Class goal: within the operating band, output ≥ 28 t/d and power ≤ 2300 kW·h/t, held for 15 s
电流密度越界 → 膜干涸穿孔 → 氢氯相遇: Current density over the limit → membrane dries out and perforates → hydrogen meets chlorine
A. 为提高产量，把电流密度一直往上推: A. To raise output, keep pushing the current density up
产量确实跟着涨，但槽电压与发热也在涨（欧姆热按电流平方增长），膜在失水。: Output does rise, but so do cell voltage and heating (ohmic heat grows with the square of current), and the membrane loses water.
B. 越过 6.5 kA/m²，膜局部干涸: B. Beyond 6.5 kA/m², the membrane dries out locally
膜含水不足，局部电流集中，膜面出现针孔。: With too little water in the membrane, current concentrates locally and pinholes appear in the membrane.
C. 膜穿孔，阴极室 H₂ 窜进阳极室: C. The membrane perforates and H₂ from the cathode chamber leaks into the anode chamber
氯中含氢升高，本该被在线分析仪抓到并报警。: Hydrogen in chlorine rises, which the online analyzer should catch and alarm on.
D. 联锁未动作，氢氯混合气被引发: D. The interlock fails to act and the hydrogen–chlorine mixture is ignited
本演示预设了危险组成、光照引发条件与联锁失效；现实处理是联锁先动作、切断电流停车: This demonstration assumes a dangerous composition, a light trigger and interlock failure; in reality the interlock acts first, cutting the current and shutting down.
电流密度按膜与槽的设计上限运行，不越「超高」区（> 6.0 kA/m²）: Run current density within the membrane and cell design limit, never into the "ultra-high" zone (> 6.0 kA/m²)
氯中含氢在线分析仪 + 超限联锁停车（本课不出百分比，工业上是必测指标）: Online hydrogen-in-chlorine analyzer + over-limit interlock shutdown (no percentages in this lesson; in industry it's a mandatory measurement)
阳极液加酸、控制 pH，减少氯酸盐与阳极腐蚀: Add acid to the anolyte to control pH, reducing chlorate and anode corrosion
控制膜两侧压差，防止膜抖动与反渗（本课只作定性提示，不出数字）: Control the pressure difference across the membrane to prevent flutter and back-migration (qualitative only in this lesson, no numbers)
定期测膜、按期换膜，别等穿孔: Test membranes regularly and replace them on schedule; don't wait for perforation
记住这条链：电流越大 → 槽电压与发热上升 → 膜干涸穿孔 → 氢氯相遇。保护正: Remember this chain: more current → higher cell voltage and heating → membrane dries out and perforates → hydrogen meets chlorine. When protection works normally, the result is shutdown, not explosion.
本课目标：搞清膜为什么必须挡、电流密度与电耗的账怎么算，最后在操作带里把产碱稳在: Lesson goal: understand why the membrane must block, how the current density and power-use account works, and finally hold caustic output above 28 t/d within the operating band for 15 seconds.
电解饱和食盐水时，阴极的产物是: In the electrolysis of saturated brine, the cathode products are
水溶液里 Na⁺ 不放电，阴极是 2H₂O + 2e⁻ → H₂↑ + 2OH⁻: Na⁺ doesn't discharge in aqueous solution; the cathode reaction is 2H₂O + 2e⁻ → H₂↑ + 2OH⁻ and the products are H₂ and NaOH; sodium metal requires electrolysis of molten NaCl.
盐水精制里属于「硬约束」的是: Which is a "hard constraint" in brine purification?
必须严格按 BaCl₂ → Na₂CO₃ → NaOH 的唯一顺序: The order BaCl₂ → Na₂CO₃ → NaOH must be followed exactly
Na₂CO₃ 必须在 BaCl₂ 之后、盐酸必须在过滤之后: Na₂CO₃ must come after BaCl₂, and HCl must come after filtration
盐酸必须和 Na₂CO₃ 同时加: HCl must be added together with Na₂CO₃
Na₂CO₃ 既要沉淀 Ca²⁺，也要把过量 Ba²⁺ 变成 BaCO₃，所以必: Na₂CO₃ both precipitates Ca²⁺ and turns excess Ba²⁺ into BaCO₃, so it must come after BaCl₂; adding HCl early redissolves the precipitated CaCO₃ and Mg(OH)₂. Where NaOH is added is a process choice (the flocs help settling).
氯碱离子交换膜让什么通过: What does the chlor-alkali ion-exchange membrane let through?
Na⁺（带水）通过，Cl⁻ 与 OH⁻ 被排斥: Na⁺ (with water), while Cl⁻ and OH⁻ are repelled
膜内固定基团带负电（—SO₃⁻、—COO⁻），排斥阴离子，只放 Na⁺ 带水通过: The fixed groups in the membrane are negatively charged (—SO₃⁻, —COO⁻), repel anions and let only Na⁺ through with water: blocking Cl⁻ keeps the caustic pure, blocking OH⁻ keeps current efficiency up.
没有膜时烧碱被污染的直接原因是: Without a membrane, the direct cause of caustic contamination is
Cl₂ 与 NaOH 反应生成次氯酸盐（热浓碱下还会生成氯酸钠）: Cl₂ reacts with NaOH to form hypochlorite (and sodium chlorate in hot concentrated caustic)
无膜时阳极的 Cl₂ 会溶进阴极液与 NaOH 反应：教材写法（常温）Cl₂ +: Without a membrane, Cl₂ from the anode dissolves into the catholyte and reacts with NaOH: textbook form (room temperature) Cl₂ + 2NaOH → NaCl + NaClO + H₂O; hot concentrated 32 % caustic at 90 ℃ mainly forms sodium chlorate.
其他条件不变，把电流密度从 3.3 提到 6.0 kA/m²，吨碱直流电耗: With other conditions unchanged, raising current density from 3.3 to 6.0 kA/m² makes the DC power per tonne
上升，因为槽电压随电流密度线性上升: Rise, because cell voltage rises linearly with current density
U = 2.19 + 0.27576·i，电流密度越大槽电压越大；W = 100: U = 2.19 + 0.27576·i, so higher current density means higher cell voltage; W = 1000·U/(1.492·η), so power use rises (2187 → 2712 kW·h/t).
工业上为什么不用电耗最低的 1.0 kA/m²: Why doesn't industry use 1.0 kA/m², where power use is lowest?
同样大的槽产量太小（9.18 t/d），设备投资摊不回来: The same cell produces too little (9.18 t/d) to recover the equipment investment
这一区间膜会穿孔: The membrane perforates in this range
这一区间电流效率最低: Current efficiency is lowest in this range
电耗低是因为产量也低；1.0 kA/m² 只有 9.18 t/d，同样的槽和人工: Power use is low because output is low too; at 1.0 kA/m² it's only 9.18 t/d, so the same cell and labor produce a tenth of the caustic, which can't pay off. Industry uses an operating band balancing output and power use.
氯中含氢升高，工业上正确的处理是: When hydrogen in chlorine rises, the correct industrial response is
继续运行，等下次检修再说: Keep running and deal with it at the next maintenance
先降电流密度，靠在线分析与联锁停车把装置切出来: Lower the current density first, and use online analysis and interlock shutdown to take the unit offline
加大电流把氢气烧掉: Raise the current to burn off the hydrogen
把阳极液 pH 调得更低就不必管: Lower the anolyte pH further and ignore it
氯中含氢是必测的安全指标：先降负荷，再由在线分析 + 联锁切断电流停车查膜。本课: Hydrogen in chlorine is a mandatory safety measurement: reduce load first, then online analysis + interlock cut the current and shut down to inspect the membrane. This lesson's accident branch only demonstrates the worst path, "protection failure".
在不超电耗线的条件下多产碱，真正起作用的是: To make more caustic without exceeding the power line, what really works is
提高槽温，因为它同时增产又降电耗: Raise cell temperature, because it increases output and lowers power at once
提高电流密度：产量成正比涨，电耗线性涨，所以在操作带内调: Raise current density: output rises proportionally and power linearly, so adjust within the operating band
拆掉膜，减少电阻: Remove the membrane to cut resistance
产碱与电流密度成正比，电耗随电流密度线性升；槽温只通过槽电压影响电耗、不直接增产: Caustic output is proportional to current density and power rises linearly with it; cell temperature only affects power through cell voltage and doesn't directly increase output (this lesson locks the assessment step at 90 ℃). Removing the membrane doesn't lower resistance; it just contaminates the product.
膜已选中：看 Na⁺ 怎么带水穿过这层膜: Membrane selected: watch how Na⁺ crosses it with water
盐水精制已切断：钙镁开始进膜，电流效率往下掉: Brine purification cut off: calcium and magnesium enter the membrane and current efficiency falls
盐水精制已投用：效率停止下降，但已经结的垢不会自己掉: Brine purification back on: efficiency stops falling, but scale already formed won't come off by itself
膜已拆：Cl₂ 与 OH⁻ 互窜，烧碱被污染；H₂ 与 Cl₂ 已经在同一空间: Membrane removed: Cl₂ and OH⁻ cross over and contaminate the caustic; H₂ and Cl₂ are now in the same space
膜已装回：Na⁺ 带水通过，Cl⁻ 与 OH⁻ 被挡回本室: Membrane reinstalled: Na⁺ passes with water, Cl⁻ and OH⁻ are kept in their own chambers
异常：夜班把电流密度调到 2.6 kA/m²（产碱 23.88 t/d）——自己: Fault: the night shift set current density to 2.6 kA/m² (output 23.88 t/d); bring it back into the operating band
达标：产碱与电耗同时守住，保持 15 s: Passed: output and power use both held for 15 s
已回到参考工况：3.3 kA/m²、90 ℃、精制开、膜已装: Back to the reference case: 3.3 kA/m², 90 ℃, purification on, membrane installed
紧急停车：电流已降回参考工况，联锁解除: Emergency shutdown: current back to the reference case, interlock released
抢修完成：换膜、复位参数，重新开车: Repair complete: membrane replaced, parameters reset, restarting
